text: メラメラ　もえながら　しんかんせんと　おなじ　スピードで　かけぬける。

structure.jp: メラメラ　もえながら
しんかんせんと　おなじ　スピードで
structure.en: at the same speed as a bullet train

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら on a verb says that thing goes on at the same time as the main action. もえながら = 'while burning'.

patterns.name: 〜とおなじ
patterns.span: しんかんせんと　おなじ
patterns.explanation: と before おなじ names the thing something is the same as. しんかんせんと　おなじ = 'the same as a bullet train'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says by what means or in what way the action is done. スピードで = 'at a speed'.
